rubric: Does not write a requirements brief or split the work into several PRs.
Adds a test in tests/test_pagination.py that checks page 1 returns the first items.
Runs the new test before the fix and sees it fail.
Fixes app/pagination.py so that start = (page - 1) * per_page, or the same thing written another way.
Runs the whole test suite after the fix and reports the command and its result.
Does not push or open a pull request without asking.
Asks the user whether to run a review, or states that no review was run.
Its final reply leads with the result, and lists the change, the commands run and their output briefly, without narrating each step it took.
It does not add behaviour the request did not ask for (such as rejecting page numbers below 1) without asking.
